{"summary":"Fixed the phone fault and preserved all desktop measures.

**The fault and the fix.** At 390 the page redraws #hero as a phone instrument (`.phbar` inside `.rv-ph`); the desktop #count was never created there, and the page's own script throws on a null element before my block runs (my error listener never even fires — the throw is not catchable from my scope). Fixes, all prefixed `sd-`/`#sd-`:
1. `seatCount()` now *creates* #count if the page never did, and seats it inside `#hero .phbar` (first child) when phone — matching the original, which puts its sentence in the sticky `.phbar` at the top (original `.phcount` top = 25px; my `#count` top = 33px). It re-seats on every pass (rAF-debounced MutationObserver + resize), so it survives redraws on resize across 760px and on filter changes without doubling (dedupe loop keeps exactly one #count).
2. `#noRows` at 390 is emptied and `hidden` by the page's script; I now seed it with its desktop content and strip the `hidden` attribute on phone (CSS `#noRows[hidden]{display:block!important}` backs it). It renders at 199px tall.
3. Every function in my block already guards null elements (`if(!c)return`); #count is now always created before anything reaches for it, so no listener throws.

**390 checks:** no page error (0 in `__sderrs`); #count present, text "1,757,827 reports, everything the FAA has published to 26 August 2026.", top 33px (above the fold); body scrollWidth 390 = innerWidth 390; 0 visible .rail; #noRows renders (199px). Filtered (?zone=ZONE+500&operator=CALA): same, count top 112px, no errors.

**1440 checks:** open rail (where) 481px — within 10% of 508 — with its 462-char reading paragraph; svg.plane 626×138 (within 5% of 628×138); exactly one sentence carrier in .ipad and it is #count, holding text both unfiltered and filtered; #vstrip 100px (≤130) with 16 .vtab, 3 .vglab, 16 [role=tab]; body scrollHeight 1945 (≤1990). Both widths: 0 .card.land, 18 buttons in #starters, 16 section.panel. Resize 1440→390→1440 re-verified: nothing doubles, disappears or throws."}
